tools.name: list_news
tools.title: List portal news
tools.description: List recent news and announcements published on the Khánh Hòa provincial portal, optionally filtered by category or a keyword in the title.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. 'Y tế', 'Giao thông', 'Chính sách'.

query.description: Optional keyword to match against the article title.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return (default 10).

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.title: List departments and localities
tools.description: List the provincial departments/agencies (sở, ban, ngành) and the local administrative units (xã, phường, đặc khu) of Khánh Hòa province.

kind.description: Which set to return: departments, localities, or all (default).

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.title: Get portal contact info
tools.description: Get the official contact details of the Khánh Hòa provincial portal: address, phone numbers, email, managing office and website.
